note: Food now looks like food: beer shows a proper mug and corn shows an ear of corn in your inventory, at market stalls, and in dungeon shops, and the market-stall counters display Kenney food — bread, burgers, pie, cooked meat, sushi, and tacos — instead of the old pixel sprites. Health potions keep their flask mark (the kit has no potion art), and prices, healing, and effects are unchanged. The other 192 food pictures from the kit sit in the game files ready for future dishes.
